pages.text: These structures are centered around one or more Alteration Catalysts and are oftentimes built in a way to express the nature - and what some may call the 'beauty' - of the Risus. They can feature patches of remains, carved symbols, gore and ritual circles. At their center is an $(l:blocks/alteration_catalyst)$(c)$(o)Alteration Catalyst$() which grants someone the ability to imbue materials with the essence of the Risus.

pages.title: Small Alteration Site
pages.text: This is one of the smallest Alteration Sites but it fulfills all basic needs.
